answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to a VDF transcript generated by a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings. For challenge labels such as velvet, saffron, and ocean, every next state depends on the previous one, so cloning identities creates separate time-locks rather than scalable shared work. GPUs may run chains concurrently, but cannot reduce the mandatory depth of each chain, imposing a strict physical wall-clock bottleneck.
